description:
AECOM is currently seeking a Resident Engineer for a project location within the New Jersey Metro area.



The responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to:
 Multi-contract management, Construction Management, Project Management responsibilities (To include; staffing, budget, deliverables, project status reports)
 Ability to work in teams providing strong leadership abilities. Decisive under pressure with a calm personality with thorough understanding of all aspects of contract administration will be required.
 A demonstrated understanding of managing multiple, complex, interconnected construction schedules in a congested and active treatment plant is essential. 
 Reviewing project progress and schedule requiring  strong construction coordination skills
 QA/QC program compliance
 Final review and authorization of contractor payments including confirmation of Prevailing Wage interviews with trades per SOP
 Good disputes avoidance skills and ability to align interests and keep different parties working together.  Will be responsible for review and resolution and/or approval of Inspector and Contractor reporting, forms, testing, compliance and coordination issues.
 Participates in the negotiation of all Change Orders
 Reviewing the contractor’s CPM schedule with assistance from the Scheduler, to assure that the schedule conforms to the CPM format required by the contract documents   
 Notification to the contractor of any work that does not conform to the requirements of the contract documents. This shall be accomplished by issuing the formal Notice of Non-Conformance
 Confirming that the contractor is submitting all submittals for review in a timely fashion so as not to inhibit the progress of the work
 Establishing and maintaining the project files
 Review of Client draft letters
 Review of Monthly Client Reports
 Assist inspection staff in expediting solutions to technical field problems with design
 Establish, update and write project procedures and Project Work Plan
 Monitor safety activities per AECOM scope of work
 Verifying that all field testing, start-up, and operation and maintenance   training activities are conducted in accordance with the contract documents
  

 Minimum Requirements 
 Bachelor's degree in Civil or Environmental engineering and 8 years of related experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and /or education.
 New Jersey (PE) license
 Construction Management experience on at least one large, long term wastewater, high value wastewater treatment capital improvement program (or aggregate of $350M+ in value)
 Knowledge of applicable codes and regulations
 OSHA 30
 Valid U.S. Driving License
 Preferred Qualifications 
 15+ years of construction experience in the Wastewater industry
 CCM Qualification
 Working With FEMA
 
 Relocation assistance is not available for this role.
 Sponsorship for US Employment Authorization is not available now or in the future for this position.
 THIS POSTING IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY, AND AECOM INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY JANUARY 28, 2027 
 
 At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment. 
  
 About AECOM  
 AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options ,  well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan. 
 AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com. 
 What makes AECOM a great place to work  
 You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity. 
 As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
